# PixelLayout

[DotGame.Imaging](README.md) · `DotGame.Imaging` · enum

```csharp
public enum PixelLayout
```

How the pixels in a buffer are laid out: the order of their channels and the bytes each takes.

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| <a name="rgba32"></a>`Rgba32` | Four bytes a pixel, red, green, blue and alpha in that order, 8 bits each; rows from the top, pixels from the left, with nothing between rows. |
